record.summary: Task addition receipt.
Switched all work to codex/collaborative-skill-upgrade, added the no-direct-main-push repository rule and verified agy exposes gemini-4-argon-high.

Independent review completed via agy.exe using gemini-4-argon-high with high effort, plan mode and sandbox. Runner exited 0; conversation [redacted-initial-review-session]; disposition REQUEST_CHANGES (2 P2 and 2 P3), not product approval. Branch is codex/collaborative-skill-upgrade; all 25 reviewed file hashes remained unchanged. Reviewer performed static inspection only; Codex then reproduced all four findings against the built CLI in isolated temporary fixtures. GEMINI-UPGR-001 P2: SkillInspection.cs:59 reports a retired baseline file as extra even when absent locally and absent from the current package. Reproduction: exists=false, extra=1, in_sync=false, exit=1. Local deletion relative to the old baseline is a real historical change; the defect is the nonexistent extra/current-content mismatch. GEMINI-UPGR-002 P2: SkillCommand.cs:259/329 mislabels invalid UTF-8 file content as INVALID_ARGUMENT without a path. Skill and Schema diff can emit partial unified output before decoding a later file fails. Reproduced skill exit=2 with 23645 stdout characters; schema exit=2 with 2263 stdout characters; neither diagnostic identified the file. Improve path-specific encoding diagnostics and output completeness without adding upgrade approval gates. GEMINI-UPGR-003 P3: SkillCommand.cs:322 serializes XML diff text with XElement.ToString, losing carriage returns on parse. Reproduced schema unified diff contained 126 CR characters while parsed XML diff contained zero; texts differed. Use explicit XML writer settings and entitize CR to preserve payload text. GEMINI-UPGR-004 P3: SkillCommand.cs:127 omits overwritten local files newly introduced to the current managed set but absent from the baseline, and reports changes already equal to the embedded target as replaced. Reproduced locally-modified file actually overwritten with replaced count zero, and unchanged SKILL.md falsely reported replaced. XML file receipt paths also mix Windows separators at line 156. Align receipts with actual target writes.
record.outcome: Raw review and replayable fixture script: $REVIEW_ARTIFACTS/initial/review.txt; reproduce-findings.ps1; reproductions.json. The semantic findings are preserved in this task record. No implementation fixes, commits or pushes were performed during review.
